Burham has finished his speech, which lasted about 35 minutes. I could just about hear him on the hot mic saying “sorry that went on a bit” as he shook someone’s hand off camera.

posts.text: The prime minister said he is making a “serious and genuine offer” to the Scottish government to put more control “in the hands of local people”. posts.title: Burnham says he is in Scotland with 'a big offer' to give more power to people and places
posts.text: Burnham said he wants to give more power to people and places in order for them to “change things for themselves”. He said: I care about Scotland a lot, and I am coming today with a big offer and in search of common ground. When I walked into Downing Street in July, I said I wanted to do politics differently. Place…
Lots of cheers from the young audience after Burnham concedes he is in the “true north”. “Please don’t tell anyone in Manchester,” he joked.
